name: Workflow Goal Node
description: On-demand Agent guide for reading and updating Goal nodes through typed backend actions only.

singleGoalPerGroup.rule: A magnetic group that contains a Timer and an Agent may contain at most one Goal node.
singleGoalPerGroup.onRejected: If the backend rejects creating or connecting a second Goal with goal_already_bound, stop: the group already has a Goal bound to its Timer. Do not force a second Goal into the group.

controlSurface.storage: Goal/task state sidecars are backend-owned diagnostic storage, never an Agent control surface.
controlSurface.connectionRequirement: Agent-authored Goal edits require a linked bidirectional goal edge.

prohibitions: Never edit `Harness/a2a/**/state.json` directly — use typed actions.
Never edit Goal or task state files directly.
Never mutate the workflow map file.
Never create or connect a second Goal into a Timer/Agent group that already has one (goal_already_bound).
